title: Randomly Optimized
description: Are you tired of always lagging on Minecraft? well wait no more, this mod pack has the best mods to optimize your experience in Minecraft
body:
## Performance
**Randomly Optimized** is built for smooth gameplay on any device. With carefully selected performance mods like **Lithium, FerriteCore, ThreadTweak, Entity Culling, More Culling, BadOptimizations, and Krypton**, your worlds load faster, FPS spikes are reduced, and gameplay feels smooth.

## Feels familiar
Randomly Optimized keeps Minecraft classic while improving performance. Features like **Zoomify**, **ImmediatelyFast**, and **Debugify** make gameplay faster and menus snappier, all without changing vanilla mechanics.

## Works everywhere
This modpack contains **no content-changing mods**, so it works on any server or world. Use any launcher and enjoy performance improvements without conflicts.

## Up to date
The modpack is built for **Minecraft 1.21.11** and receives regular updates. Updating is simple and preserves your settings wherever possible.

## Built on Fabric
Randomly Optimized uses the **Fabric mod loader**, which is lightweight, fast, and compatible with a wide range of mods. It includes **Fabric API, Architectury API, Cloth Config API, Fabric Language Kotlin**, and **Forge Config API Port**.

## Open development
Randomly Optimized welcomes **community feedback**. Report bugs, suggest performance tweaks, or discuss ideas on Discord. Most included mods are open-source, and the modpack is built transparently.

## Helpful community
Join our **Discord server** for support, optimization tips, and discussions. Our community is friendly and dedicated to helping Minecraft run its best.

## FAQ

**Q: How do I install or update the modpack?**  

**A:** Full instructions are available on our Discord guides.

**Q: Can I use this on servers?**  

**A:** Yes! Since no content mods are included, it works on any vanilla-compatible server.

**Q: What mods are included?**  

**A:** The pack features: Lithium, FerriteCore, ThreadTweak, Entity Culling, More Culling, BadOptimizations, VulkanMod, NoisiumForked, Dark Loading Screen, Zoomify, ScalableLux, ImmediatelyFast, Mod Menu, Architectury API, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, Forge Config API Port, and more — all selected for maximum performance.

**Q: How can I contribute or give feedback?**  

**A:** Join our Discord or open issues on GitHub.

**Q: More questions?**  

**A:** Chat with us on Discord anytime!
